notes: Raw ParticleSystem modules retained, including disabled modules. Enabled Collision/SubModule/ClampVelocity/RotationBySpeed/Force cannot be silently discarded.

The iTween target is the collision-plane Transform, not the particles root. Its original local position and quaternion define the plane. Native collision and sub-emission are a renderer compatibility boundary.
All record references resolve through exact original PPtrs. Names are diagnostic labels, never the reference authority.
PremiumMaterialSwitcher materials are serialized auxiliary dependencies; non-premium renderers use their own original material array.
